Plugin.Name: Time Machine Discovery
Plugin.Overview:
Makes Unraid shares exported as "Yes (Time Machine)" actually appear in the macOS Time Machine disk picker.
Time Machine needs the server to advertise an _adisk._tcp mDNS record alongside _smb._tcp. Unraid publishes only the latter, so a Time Machine share can be fully visible in Finder and completely absent from Time Machine. This plugin reads the running Samba config and publishes the missing record, following share changes automatically and leaving Unraid's own avahi file untouched.
